Cadence v1 · Twenty directions

Eight directions, four experiments

Each shortlisted direction is pushed four ways. Every experiment changes one thing, so you can see what it did. The copy, the published price and Ada’s sample week are the same on every page.

Last round’s notes are applied in all four experiments. Open a cell for the full page; the bar at the bottom switches experiment, direction and page. Animate and delight pages respond to you: the “Try” line says where. Shortlist what is worth taking further, then copy your picks and send them back.

Bolder

Turn up the move it already owns.

Distill

Remove what does not earn its place.

Animate

One authored motion moment.

Delight

One moment that rewards use.

32 variants

  1. 02

    Signal

    Navy-black, one electric blue, the mark at monumental size.

    Sean’s favourite so far.

    v1 original

    Bolder

    Today’s blue column becomes the spine: a full-height hero field that runs into the timesheet.

    Landing Timesheet

    Distill

    One blue, one surface: no panels, no cell boxes, features as one list.

    Landing Timesheet

    Animate

    The mark draws itself to your local time, the week fills, and totals tick with the timer.

    Try Watch the landing load; on the timesheet, wait 8 seconds.

    Landing Timesheet

    Delight

    Keyboard mastery: a gliding blue cursor, 1.5 or 90m becomes 1:30, and ? opens shortcuts.

    Try Click a cell, use the arrows, type 1.5, press ?

    Landing Timesheet

  2. 03

    Evergreen

    Forest-night canvas, mint at full saturation, mono figures.

    Smaller day blocks, sized like Signal’s.

    v1 original

    Bolder

    Today turns solid mint with forest figures, one mint call to action, and the headline spans the page.

    Landing Timesheet

    Distill

    Forest, mint and one cream ink. Rules replace panels, features run as a list, one call to action.

    Landing Timesheet

    Animate

    Figures roll in like an odometer, column by column, and the timer’s seconds roll live.

    Try Watch the week roll in, then edit a cell.

    Landing Timesheet

    Delight

    Stopping the timer folds its pill into today’s cell; starting a row lifts one out.

    Try Stop the timer, then press start on any row.

  3. 11

    Dial

    The mark’s clock face becomes the geometry: rings, arcs, dials.

    v1 original

    Bolder

    The week dial fills the first screen with the headline in its face; a large week ring anchors the timesheet.

    Landing Timesheet

    Distill

    One thin ring with the week total in its centre, a plain feature list and borderless cells.

    Landing Timesheet

    Animate

    The hand sweeps the week and lays down each day’s arc. Then the timer ring ticks live.

    Try Watch the hand fill Monday to Wednesday, then edit a cell.

    Landing Timesheet

    Delight

    Turn the dial’s hand to a day and a readout lists that day’s projects and hours.

    One Thing

    Monochrome everything except the one action.

    New colours and a dark mode. Try the swatches and the theme switch in the review bar.

    v1 original

    Bolder

    Heaviest ink: a one-line headline, a full-bleed action bar and a wider solid today slab.

    Landing Timesheet

    Distill

    No rules or outlines, shorter copy, no project markers. Delete buttons appear on hover.

    Landing Timesheet

    Animate

    The accent travels to whatever the one action is now: Stop, Track time or the header.

    Delight

    Track time opens a composer in place and the page dims. Saved hours land in the cells.

    Cyanotype

    A blueprint: white linework on prussian blue.

    Both liked it, but it was hard for everyday users. Now the data reads plainly and the blueprint is atmosphere.

    v1 original

    Bolder

    An annotated drawing of the app fills the first screen, each feature pointing at its part.

    Poster

    A typographic poster in a blue-and-amber duotone.

    Cyrus’s favourite; Sean liked it too.

    v1 original

    Bolder

    A viewport-wide staircase headline and a bigger sun sinking into a blue band. The greeting is set as poster type.

    Distill

  8. 18

    Spectrum

    The six project colours lead: the week as stacked colour segments.

    v1 original

    Bolder

    The hero becomes full-bleed day columns sized by hours; timesheet rows become full colour bands.

    Landing Timesheet

    Distill

    Pastel bands, tiles, boxes and green are gone. Colour stays only on data: segments and project markers.

    Landing Timesheet

    Animate

    The week stacks in day by day as totals tally. Editing a cell resizes its segment live.

    Try Reload, then type 3 into Annual audit’s Wednesday cell.

    Delight

    Point at a project to light its hours across the week, with its share of the total.

    Try Hover or tap a project; tap again to release.

Design mockups for review, not shipped product. The copy, prices and timesheet structure come from Cadence’s landing page, pricing.json and UI doctrine. Sample data: Ada’s week of October 26, 2026, with a timer running.

Fonts are open-licence faces served by Google Fonts.
